env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd on
logos build -o $WORK/on$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
exec $WORK/on$GOEXE
stderr '^done$'
cd ..

cd off
! logos build -o $WORK/off$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/godep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
cd ..

-- on/go.mod --
module example.com/capon

go 1.27

require example.com/godep v0.0.0

replace example.com/godep => ../godep

-- on/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_exec_allowlist = ["example.com/godep/**"]

-- on/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/godep"

func main() {
	godep.Init()
	println("done")
}

-- off/go.mod --
module example.com/capoff

go 1.27

require example.com/godep v0.0.0

replace example.com/godep => ../godep

-- off/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- off/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/godep"

func main() {
	godep.Init()
	println("done")
}

-- godep/go.mod --
module example.com/godep

go 1.27

-- godep/dep.go --
package godep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
}
